article.headline: Wisne scores 22 in Northern Colorado's 82-75 win over Denver
article.description: — Brock Wisne scored 22 points as Northern Colorado beat Denver 82-75 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Wisne scores 22 in Northern Colorado's 82-75 win over Denver
article.story: DENVER -- — Brock Wisne scored 22 points as Northern Colorado beat Denver 82-75 on Saturday night. Wisne added five rebounds for the Bears (8-5). Langston Reynolds scored 21 points and added five assists. Isaiah Hawthorne had 16 points and shot 6 for 10, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc. Nicholas Shogbonyo finished with 21 points for the Pioneers (6-9). Josh Lee added 14 points for Denver. Sebastian Akins also had 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
